releaseNotes:
• VoiceX is now Voice Engineering, with a new icon and a new design: colour modules, big numbers, a hatched meter of your last ten days, and four pages — Home, History, Dictionary, Settings. Light and dark.
• In the Dock while it's open (Keep in Dock works). Quitting from the Dock keeps the key working from the menu bar; Quit in the menu bar icon's menu quits completely.
• Arabic, more accurate. An optional high-accuracy model that runs on your Mac (Settings ▸ Language, a one-time 1.6 GB download) made about half as many mistakes on Gulf and Saudi speech in our tests, and words said before a pause are no longer lost.
…and more.
